name: trigger_derived_down
comment: ADR-0042 + ADR-0018: a trigger's rollback derives from its snapshots — guard on this version's rendering, drop, recreate the previous declaration through the dialect; at the creating version, drop only. The multi-event declaration (update, delete) renders as one trigger per event on SQLite and reads back as one declaration.

snapshots.sql: update widgets set name = name where id in (select n.id from {new: id} n);
update widgets set name = name where id in (select o.id from {old: id} o);

up: create table widgets (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT) STRICT

trigger.sql: update widgets set name = name where id in (select n.id from {new: id} n);

expectTrigger.sql: update widgets set name = name where id in (select n.id from {new: id} n);

trigger.sql: update widgets set name = name where id in (select o.id from {old: id} o);

trg_widgets.sql: update widgets set name = name where id in (select o.id from {old: id} o);
update widgets set name = name where id in (select n.id from {new: id} n);
